summary: The agent builds a robust multi-model ensemble (LightGBM and a TabularResNet) with extensive feature engineering and a weighted blend. However, it introduces significant data leakage by performing imputation, TF-IDF/SVD fitting, and categorical frequency encoding on the full training dataset before splitting out the validation set.
